summary: Job isolation settings: AWX_ISOLATION_BASE_PATH (Job Execution Path, default /tmp) sets the staging area, and AWX_ISOLATION_SHOW_PATHS (Paths to expose to isolated jobs) mounts extra host directories into the execution environment, set in Jobs settings or /api/v2/settings/jobs.
questions: How do I change the job staging directory from /tmp in automation controller?
How do I mount a host directory into the execution environment for jobs?
If I expose a file path, what gets mounted?

answer_card.title: Expose host paths to controller jobs
answer_card.answer_md:
Set these in **Settings > Jobs** (or `PATCH /api/v2/settings/jobs`):

- **Job Execution Path**: `AWX_ISOLATION_BASE_PATH = "/opt/tmp"` (staging area, default `/tmp`)
- **Paths to expose to isolated jobs**: `AWX_ISOLATION_SHOW_PATHS = ['/list/of/', '/paths']`

If you list a file, its whole containing directory is mounted into the execution environment. Keys or settings used from those paths should be added to `/var/lib/awx/.ssh`.
